QuestInfo.name: [Party Quest] Romeo and Juliet
QuestInfo.0:
The star-crossed lovers of #b#m261000000##k, #b#p2112004##k and #b#p2112003##k. Use the #bDimensional Mirror#k to meet Romeo and Juliet, and find the true cause of the hatred between the Zenumists and the Alcadnos! Start by finding the strange switch in the laboratory, then eliminate all monsters that appear. Next, collect the strange liquid inside the beaker. Then, enter the dark laboratory and obtain the experimental data. After eliminating the monsters, find another strange switch. Locate the correct foothold and climb up. Finally, eliminate Frankenroid!
